notes: All cases retained; public async and internal sync diagnostic are distinct.
Flat arena; Nitro recursive DTO generator pilot failed. No recursive DTO parity claim.
Setup is warm full tree replacement and dense index rebuild, not cold initialization.
p50/p95 summarize batch per-operation means; confidence intervals compare per-launch arithmetic means using log ratios. GC outliers can separate median ratios from reported mean-ratio estimates.
Internal diagnostic Rustra closure includes a registry lookup per call. No public sync claim.

Owned-buffer external-memory pressure differed: Nitro reports backing-store bytes; baseline Rustra does not. Pinned Hermes external MutableBuffer storage is not automatically credited. Buffer classifications are diagnostic and not fairness-normalized acceptance; original samples/statistics are preserved.
